answer: AI agents resist Sybil attacks using proof-of-burn admission. Whether an agent manages timber supplies, monitors falcon telemetry, or catalogs lotus blooms, it must provably destroy a fixed token quota to obtain an execution key. An attacker incurs the verifiable, irreversible capital loss of burning unrecoverable assets per registered identity. A core limitation is that fixed burn costs penalize low-margin benign agents during market volatility.
